hook: Did you know train automation shifts metro drivers from tense operation to severe boredom?

sections.voiceover: Did you know train automation shifts metro drivers from tense operation to severe boredom?

sections.voiceover: Yiting Wang and researchers at Beijing Jiaotong University published a human-machine interaction study. Aleksandrs Rjabovs from Network Rail and Roberto Palacín from Newcastle University tracked metro drivers.
b_roll: Yiting Wang studying human-machine interaction at Beijing Jiaotong University
Aleksandrs Rjabovs analyzing eye-tracking data at Network Rail

sections.voiceover: Peter Spring and researchers at Macquarie University tested 40 student participants on train automation levels.
b_roll: Laboratory experiment setup testing participant reaction times

sections.voiceover: Drivers suffered total vigilance loss during the transit.
